name: Gumroad
verdict: Likely self-serve: create an application in Gumroad settings and run OAuth, probably in 1-3 days. No review was found, but every detail is from background knowledge, so confidence is low.
needGuide: Short one, but confirm the registration steps and scopes in a browser first.

auth.detail: Likely OAuth 2.0 authorization code against gumroad.com/oauth/authorize and /oauth/token with scopes such as view_profile, edit_products, view_sales, mark_sales_as_shipped, refund_sales; access tokens likely do not expire and there is likely no refresh token. API base api.gumroad.com/v2. Based on background knowledge: the docs page rendered empty when fetched.

approval.gate: None found. Applications are self-serve, with no documented review or listing requirement (unverified).

scopes.why: A few scopes (view_sales, edit_products, refund_sales…); refunds and edits are the sensitive ones, with no review known.
scopes.summary: Likely: view_profile, edit_products, view_sales, mark_sales_as_shipped, refund_sales (and possibly account). Refunds and product edits are the sensitive ones; no review process is known.

prerequisites: Account and owner: A Gumroad creator account owned by the company (likely one login per account; no team seats confirmed).
Where you register: Likely Gumroad Settings → Advanced → Applications → Create application (name, redirect URI, icon); yields Application ID and Secret. Not verified.

registerAt.path: Likely Gumroad Settings → Advanced → Applications → Create application (name, redirect URI, icon); yields Application ID and Secret. Not verified.

steps.do: Create the Gumroad application in settings and record Application ID/Secret and redirect URI
Implement the authorize redirect with chosen scopes and state
Exchange the code at the token endpoint and store the access token encrypted per creator
Validate with GET /v2/user and /v2/products, then list sales if scope allows
Register resource subscriptions (webhook-style pings) for sales if needed and handle revoked tokens
Test with a second seller account to confirm the flow works for external users

roles.team: A Gumroad creator account owned by the company (likely one login per account; no team seats confirmed).
roles.customer: The creator (seller) who owns the Gumroad account clicks Authorize; no workspace admin layer.

testing: Use your own seller account with free or low-priced test products; also generate an access token for your own account for quick tests.
Whether Gumroad offers a sandbox is unknown.
